column1: # VFS seed list (decision 0110, PROVISIONAL): product files of the FL Studio installer that the harness writes to the virtual volume before
# the guest runs. Used only when the harness gets FLE_VFS_SEED=<this file> (a4-multi.sh: VFS_SEED=<abs path of this file>); otherwise the
# volume is empty (decision 0018). Format and rules: lift/harness/vfs_seed.h. Three TAB-separated fields per line:
#   guest path  <TAB>  host file (relative to $FLE_VFS_SEED_ROOT = the repository root for a4-multi.sh)  <TAB>  SHA-256 of the host file
# The host files are NOT in git (lift/out*/ is ignored). Make them once, from the installer, with
# Guest directory: FLE_VIRTUAL_SHARED_DIR of lift/runtime/fle_vfs.c (decision 0104) + "Artwork\Fonts\". ILTools looks for it as the directory of
# its own GetModuleFileNameW path + "Artwork\Fonts\ILGlyphsEx.ilfont" (the marker); if the marker is there, the same directory is searched for
# "ILCursors.ilfont". If FLE_VIRTUAL_SHARED_DIR changes, change both paths here.
# Not listed on purpose (candidates, see decision 0110): OpenSans-Regular.ttf (217,360 B, SHA-256 e64e508b2aa2880f907e470c4550980ec4c0694d103a43f36150ac3f93189bee),
# the rest of the 36 files of Shared\Artwork\Fonts. Windows system fonts (Segoe UI, ...) are not in the installer and are never listed.
